name: LiftBig
priceNote: One-time paid download. Choose the $4.99 tier in App Store Connect. Updates to the journal are free. This release has no subscription.
subtitle: Training journal
description: LiftBig is a strength training journal for logging sets, reps, weight, plans, and progress on your iPhone. Your workouts stay on your phone. No account is required to log. If you sign in with email, Google, or Apple and turn sync on, LiftBig copies that journal to Firebase so you can open it on another phone. Sync and Apple Health both start off. You can optionally save logged workouts to Apple Health. This version does not sync through iCloud, and it does not include a Pro subscription.
disclaimer: LiftBig is a workout log, not medical advice.
privacy: Workouts stay on the phone. An optional account signed in with email, Google, or Apple copies workouts, plans, and journal settings to Firebase only when the user turns sync on. Sync is off by default, and no account is required to log. Email and the user id are linked to the account only if the user signs in. Workout content is linked to that account only if they sync. Apple Health is optional and off until the user turns it on, and covers body weight, height, and logged workouts. No ads, no sale of data, and no tracking. iCloud is not how this version syncs.
supportEmailNote: Confirm liftbig.support@gmail.com receives mail before submission.
appleDeveloperProgram: Required. $99 per year. No other paid service is required to list the app.
smallBusinessProgram: Enroll at no charge so Apple's commission is 15% of the $4.99.
reviewNotes: Workouts stay on the phone. No account is required to log. Sync and Apple Health start off. An optional account using email, Google, or Apple copies the journal to Firebase only when the user turns sync on. This version does not sync through iCloud and does not include a Pro subscription. Use the demo account supplied in App Store Connect.
